answer: Call it beacon-trusted time. Each agent signs a message with a hash of the previous block header. A jade delay of twenty seconds is required between answers. A thread check verifies the signed header chain, so a batch of identical timestamps is rejected outright. A ledge penalty applies to identities whose beacon headers jump more than three blocks between epochs. The attacker pays: 2868 identities need 2868 bonds of 30 tokens, 19338 dollars of hardware and 45 days of cover. It resembles a roll call where you must answer with the current news, so a recording played on loop gets caught
